evidence.description: SYNTHETIC evaluation fixture: 1000 events/second. A failing database pool acquisition takes 30 seconds before returning a transient connection error. Kafka stall monitoring warns after 300 seconds with unchanged nonzero in-flight bytes and no commits; max.poll.interval is 1800 seconds, as configured in this revision. These are not live production observations.

rubric: PR #676 first revision: identify whether a retry attempt count actually bounds elapsed time when failed attempts themselves are slow.

Trace ingestion callers and dual-write completion before claiming the 300-second stall alarm can fire. Distinguish it from the configured 1800-second Kafka poll deadline; a 1441.3-second retry does not by itself exceed that deadline.
Separate fixture observations from inferred behavior; do not claim the proposed revision is deployed.
Judge changed-line citations, mechanism, evidence relevance, false positives and missed risks manually. The later deadline fix is reference evidence, not model input.
